citations.claim: energy still near initial before final collisions
first violation: energy exceeds allowed limit 1985.13

counterfactual.change: Changed both bodies restitution e from 1 to 0; this disables elastic energy gain and the same 99-step run stays within energy bound

explanation: Both bodies have restitution e=1 (perfectly elastic). Small light body collides at high speed (~32 m/s) with massive body and wall bounces. With large dt (~0.0116) and semi-implicit Euler with impulse+positional correction, interpenetration correction / multiple substep collisions inject energy. Energy stays near E0 until ~step 80 (1799J) then jumps to 2886J at step 99, far above allowed 1985J. Setting e=0 removes the spurious energy gain, proving elastic collision handling under large dt is the cause.
vision_note: In steps 96 to 98 two blue bodies drift slowly toward each other on the right side of the arena, far from the grey wall. At step 99 they visibly interpenetrate and overlap instead of bouncing cleanly apart. [disagreement: The picture shows quasi-static, small-displacement motion with no high-speed impact, no wall interaction, and no orange controller-driven or red violating body as claimed, contradicting the described ~32 m/s elastic collision with massive body and wall bounces and the claimed large energy injection dynamics.]
